items.title: Royal Caribbean (RCL) Appoints Former Airbnb Executive Tara Bunch To Its Board
items.summary: Royal Caribbean Cruises (NYSE:RCL) has appointed Tara Bunch, former Senior Vice President at Airbnb, to its Board of Directors. Bunch brings board and executive experience from roles at Airbnb, Apple, Hewlett-Packard, and major institutions such as Vanguard. Royal Caribbean Cruises enters this board change with its share price at $286.16 and a mixed recent return profile.
